notes: Printed: '{R}{G}{W}, {T}: Rin and Seri deals damage to any target equal to the number of Dogs you control. You gain life equal to the number of Cats you control.' Dogs you control: Rin and Seri (Dog Cat) + My Dog = 2 -> opponent 20 -> 18 (the opponent's Dog does not count). Cats you control: Rin and Seri + My Cat + My Other Cat = 3 -> you gain 3, 20 -> 23 (the opponent's Cat does not count). The {T} is part of the cost: Rin and Seri ends tapped.
